title: Design System: Suntimes Prayer Times Addon

headline.purpose: Large prayer times and high-value summaries.

title.purpose: Screen titles, dates, locations, and prayer names.

label.purpose: Compact widget labels and metadata; the minimum meaningful role.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive confirmation or recovery action using the active palette.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: #00695C; color: #FFFFFF; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 24px; min-height: 40px; font: 500 14px/20px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #00574C; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,105,92,.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #004A41; }

components.name: Text Button
components.css: .ds-button-text { background: transparent; color: #00695C; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 40px; font: 500 14px/20px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-button-text:hover { background: rgba(0,105,92,.08); } .ds-button-text:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,105,92,.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-text:active { background: rgba(0,105,92,.14); }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Material-style settings input with explicit label and active outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #263238; font: 400 12px/16px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { background: #FFFFFF; color: #263238; border: 1px solid rgba(38,50,56,.55); border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px 12px; font: 400 16px/24px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #263238; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border: 2px solid #00695C; outline: 0; padding: 13px 11px; }

components.name: Information Card
components.description: Flat surface card with soft structural outline.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 2px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #263238; border: 1px solid rgba(38,50,56,.10); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 16px/24px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-card span { color: rgba(38,50,56,.70); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #00695C; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,105,92,.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Today Widget
components.description: Prayer summary container whose detail reduces responsively instead of shrinking.
components.css: .ds-widget { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 340px; max-width: 100%; background: #F6F1E6; color: #263238; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.10); border-radius: 18px; padding: 6px; font: 400 13px/18px Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-widget i { display: block; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: #00695C; } .ds-widget strong { font-size: 17px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-widget span { color: rgba(38,50,56,.70); } .ds-widget div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; text-align: center; } .ds-widget b { font-size: 12px; line-height: 17px; } .ds-widget:hover { border-color: rgba(0,105,92,.45); } .ds-widget:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,105,92,.30); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like a dependable daily reference: calm enough for repeated use, precise enough for alarms, and structured enough that the active date, location, and next prayer are never ambiguous. Native Material 3 patterns carry interaction behavior while a restrained, earth-led palette gives the product its own identity. Information hierarchy must survive small widgets, large system fonts, English, and Arabic RTL. Prayer times lead; dates, method details, prohibited windows, and night portions recede or disappear as space narrows.
keyCharacteristics: Calm earth-led color with user-selectable sapphire, rose, and dynamic alternatives.
Tonal hierarchy, soft borders, and no decorative elevation.
Location, date, next prayer, and failures remain explicit.
Responsive reduction rather than compressed text.

rules.name: The One Active Accent Rule
rules.body: Use Earth Teal, Sapphire, Rose, or Android dynamic color as the active palette—never mix palette primaries on one surface.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Color may reinforce prayer, prohibited, and night states, but labels, structure, and icons must carry the meaning independently.

rules.name: The Time Leads Rule
rules.body: A prayer time must be at least as prominent as its label, and the next prayer may receive weight and accent—not a larger decorative font.

rules.name: The No Squeezing Rule
rules.body: When content does not fit, reduce detail or change layout. Never solve narrow widths by pushing meaningful text below 11sp.

rules.name: The Flat Almanac Rule
rules.body: Persistent content uses tonal layering and borders, never decorative drop shadows.

dos: Do make date, location, and next prayer legible before secondary method details.
Do preserve 44dp activity touch targets and native Android state feedback.
Do use tonal surfaces and soft 1dp outlines for hierarchy.
Do test English, Arabic RTL, 12/24-hour time, system font scaling, light/dark themes, and compact widget widths.
Do replace unavailable data with an explicit, actionable state.
donts: Don't ship information-dense layouts without hierarchy.
Don't add decorative effects that compete with times.
Don't show ambiguous failure states or a normal-looking table of placeholders.
Don't shrink meaningful widget text below 11sp to force six columns into a compact width.
Don't combine multiple user-selectable palette accents on one surface.
